 Written Statement on behalf of Zameen Medallion /Defendant No. 04 
 
 The Defendant most respectfully submits as under: 
 
 This written reply is being submitted by M/s Zameen Med allion (P ri v a t e ) L imited/ Defendant No. 04 (hereinafter, the Defendant Company ). This written reply is being submitted by the Defendant Company through Mr. Syed Hasan Ali Shah who is fully conversant with the facts of the case and has been duly authorized in this behalf. 
 
 Preliminary Objections: 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable to the extent of the Defendant Company/Answering Defendant. It may kindly be noted that the Answering Defendant does not have any contractual relation with the Plaintiffs. Thus, to the extent of the Answering Defendant, the instant suit is liable to be dismissed under Order VII, Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. 
 
 That the suit is not proceedable against the Answering Defendant due to mis-joinder. The facts alleged in the plaint are entirely based on the document ‘Sales Invoice’ dated 16-09-2021, which is annexed with the plaint. The said ‘Sales Invoice’ has been allegedly issued by Defendants No. 1 and 2. The Answer Defendant (No. 4) has nothing to do with the transaction in question, as much as, it relates to the Plaintiff. Thus, the name of the Answering Defendant, having been impleaded improperly, should be struck out under Order I, Rule 10 (2) of CPC . 
 
 That the Suit is not proceedable against the Answering Defendant due to mis-joinder. The allegations made in the plaint are misleading and irrelevant, and the Answering Defendant has no direct nexus with the transaction in question, as much as it pertains to the Plaintiff. The Plaintiff has no cause of action against the Answering Defendant. 
 
 That the transaction in question is between the Plain tiffs and Defendants No. 1 and 2 , and the Answering Defendant has no role or liability in respect of the same. The Defendant No.4 has no sales and marketing rights of the Project as alleged by the Plaintiff. Defendant No.4 has no right, title and control over the Project. 
 
 The Defendant No. 4 is a private limited company incorporated in Pakistan and, in relation to the project “Mall of Enclave”, it is a third party merely providing services for the collection of initial down payment on behalf of the Developer of the project under contractual arrangements. The Defendant No. 4 is not a direct beneficiary of the alleged transaction. This fact is evident from a bare perusal of the above-mentioned Sales Invoice which have been annexed with the plaint and have been relied upon by the Plaintiff. As such, there is no contractual agreement between the Plaintiff and the Defendant No.1. The titled case merits dismissal forthwith on this score alone. 
 
 That the Answering Defendant is not a necessary or proper party in the titled suit. Neither the Answering Defendant has any interest in the titled suit nor has any connection with the relief claimed in the titled suit. 
 
 On Merit:

 (APPLICATION UNDER ORDER 39 RULES 1 &amp; 2 READ WITH SECTION. 151 C.P.C ALONGWITH ALL ENABLING PROVISIONS OF LAW) 
 
 
 Written Reply of Defendant No. 04 
 
 
 Preliminary Objections: 
 
 
 The Plaintiff has no locus standi to file the titled Application and also this application. Application under reply is liable to be dismissed forthwith. 
 
 To obtain interim relief a Plaintiff has to prove existence of three ingredients which are ( i ) prima facie case; (ii) irreparable loss and (iii) balance of convenience. All three factors should co-exist for being granted an interim injunction to a Plaintiff. However, in the Application under reply the Plaintiff has miserably failed to show how a prima facie case exists in his favour and what irreparable loss she would suffer. The application under reply is liable to be dismissed on this score. 
 
 Para wise Reply: 
 
 Para under reply pertains to record. 
 
 Para under reply is incorrect and misleading. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the Main Application are reiterated here. 
 
 Para under reply is incorrect and misleading. Respondent No.4 does not hold marketing rights of the project. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the Main Application are reiterated here. 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is incorrect and misleading. Applicant did not visit the office of Respondent No.4. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the Main Application are reiterated here. 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is not relevant to Respondent No.4 hence needs no reply . 
 
 Para under reply is legal. The Applicant is put to strict proof to establish balance of inconvenience in his favor. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the Main Application are reiterated here. 
 
 Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that the titled application may kindly be dismissed and interim stay already granted in favor of the Plaintiff/Petitioner may kindly be vacated.
